101B.6 / CHAPTER 6 OF 8

Token cycle, meta cycle & attention

Is a fresh token entering an exhausted theme?

8 chapters with worked investigations

01Thesis vs hygiene02Immediate rug risk03Slow extraction04Organic slow death05The self rug06Token cycle, meta cycle & attention07Due diligence keeps moving08Clear decision states

01Definition

A token has its own attention cycle. Its meta—the wider theme—can be at a different stage.

02Why it matters

A new token can enter a crowded theme just as its buyers rotate elsewhere.

03What to check

  • Token stage versus broader meta stage
  • Organic, maintained/promoted, or fabricated attention
  • Buyer persistence and a verified reason for renewal

04Healthy / Dangerous

Healthy

Independent participation persists or renews across both layers.

Dangerous

Recycled promotion masks theme fatigue or fabricated activity.

05Beginner mistake

Calling a new launch a fresh meta.

06Takeaway

Read the token and its theme separately.

Token: Emergence → Acceleration → Expansion → Maturity → Decline → Exhaustion.

Extension: Maturity → Renewal → Expansion.

Meta: Emergence → Expansion → Saturation → Rotation.

ILLUSTRATIVE · NOT A LIVE TOKEN

See the idea

  1. 01

    A fresh token launches into a heavily copied theme.

  2. 02

    Migration succeeds, but discussion and fresh buyers fade.

  3. 03

    A new token or completed event does not reset the meta.

WORKED INVESTIGATION · ILLUSTRATIVE

Work through the evidence

Mechanism and worked case

A new token can launch into a tired theme. Its contract is new, but the same story may already have exhausted attention across ten competing tokens. Conversely, an older token can receive a genuinely new catalyst without becoming a new technical launch.

How to investigate it

Keep token events, theme events, and attention evidence on separate timelines. Compare original reporting with reposts; identify what changed, when, and which exact contracts have observed participation. A fresh ticker or repeated announcement does not by itself renew the wider theme.

Check your reasoning — answered

An hour-old token repeats last week’s heavily copied theme. Is it a fresh meta? No. It is a new token whose broader theme needs separate evidence of renewed interest.

Try it on a token

See it in Meme Fast → Tweet

Review attention evidence before and after the event, then compare sampled flow in Inspect. Attention stages are a research lens, not a verified lifecycle label.

Go deeper

Organic attention comes from independent discovery and propagation. Maintained attention can depend on boosts, recurring promotion, raids, KOL posts, or small support activity. Fabricated attention uses bots, deceptive trading, or false engagement and holder counts. Categories can overlap and require evidence. A token can be in Emergence while its meta is already in Saturation. Stages are hypotheses, not official labels or a compulsory sequence. Detailed inventory and dev–buyer mechanics belong in 101C.
